outcomes.KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.a: kujadili dhana ya sitiari ili kuitofautisha na dhana zingine za lugha

outcomes.KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.c: kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri ili kuimarisha mawasiliano

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.mastery: Works out what a word means from the passage it is in, and picks the right word for a gap, and does not choose a look-alike word or a word from a nearby sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.mastery: Answers who, where, what happened and what the main message is from a short story, and puts events in order, without using outside knowledge or a detail from the wrong place, in 8 of 10 new questions.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.mastery: Gives the adjective of quality (-zuri, -kubwa, -refu, -dogo) in the form that agrees with the noun (wazuri, kikubwa, mirefu) and does not use a form from another class or the singular for many, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.mastery: Picks the demonstrative that follows the noun and agrees with its class and number (mtoto huyu, vitabu hivi, miti hii, mawe haya), and the far form (yule, kile, wale) for what is far, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.mastery: Gives the possessive that agrees with the thing owned (mwalimu wangu, kitabu changu, vitabu vyenu, jicho langu) and with the owner (-angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.mastery: Picks the greeting or farewell that fits the time and the number of people (Hujambo and Hamjambo, Kwaheri and Kwa herini, Lala salama at night, Marahaba as the answer to Shikamoo), in 8 of 10 new situations. Using them in real talk (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.mastery: Puts words in dictionary (alphabetical) order, looking at the second and third letter when the first letters match, and finds the word that comes first or last, in 8 of 10 new lists.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.mastery: Gives the number word with the prefix of its noun from one to five (wawili, vitatu, minne, matano, mtoto mmoja) and without a prefix from six (ng'ombe sita), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.mastery: Picks -ngapi (how many), -pi (which one) or gani (what kind) as the question needs, with the prefix of the noun (wangapi, vingapi, yupi, kipi, ipi), in 8 of 10 new questions.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.mastery: Gives amba- with the ending that agrees with the noun before it (mwalimu ambaye, watoto ambao, kitabu ambacho, miti ambayo) and does not leave amba- bare, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.mastery: Picks the kitendawili (riddle) from a methali, a nahau and an ordinary sentence, and gives the answer to a known riddle, in 8 of 10 new items. Setting and guessing riddles aloud (outcome b) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.mastery: Names what a fluent reader does (clear sounds, a fitting speed, a fitting voice, a pause at the koma and the kikomo, a rising voice for a question, fitting gestures) and does not take speed or loudness for fluency, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a passage aloud (outcomes b to e) is judged by a teacher listening.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.mastery: Names the styles of computer writing (herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi) and the actions kuhifadhi and kuchapisha, and does not take herufi kubwa for herufi nzito, in 8 of 10 new items. Typing a short text (outcome b) is a practical task.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.mastery: Picks mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, ninyi or wao by who speaks, who is spoken to and who is spoken about, and by one or many, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.mastery: Uses a demonstrative that stands alone in place of the noun (Huyu ni rafiki yangu, Hivi ni vitabu), with the right class and number, and tells it from the demonstrative that follows a noun, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.mastery: Uses a number word on its own in place of the noun (Wawili walichelewa, Vitatu nilimpa Wanjiru) with the prefix of the noun left out of the sentence, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.mastery: Chooses the sentence with the right alama ya hisi (!), ritifaa (') as in ng'ombe, and koloni (:) before a list, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.mastery: Picks the polite word the situation needs (tafadhali to ask, asante to thank, samahani to say sorry, pole to comfort, karibu to welcome, shikamoo to greet an elder) and the sentence that is polite, in 8 of 10 new items. Using the words in daily talk (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.mastery: Chooses the safe step when reading on a phone, tablet or computer (use a site an adult or teacher suggested, keep the password secret, ask an adult before an unknown link, log out) and not the unsafe one, in 8 of 10 new situations. Searching and opening a file (outcomes b and c) is a practical task for the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.mastery: Names the parts of a barua rasmi (anwani ya mwandikaji kulia, tarehe, anwani ya mwandikiwa kushoto, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho "Wako mwaminifu", sahihi na jina) and tells it from a friendly letter, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the letter (outcome c) is composition marking.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to YA-YA (maji, maziwa, mafuta, mate, machozi, manukato; they begin with ma- and have no singular), gives ya- as the subject prefix, and does not use li- or a prefix of another class, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.mastery: Completes a methali about unity and working together (umoja ni nguvu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, mkono mmoja haulei mwana, wengi wape) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a methali when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.mastery: Names the kind of poem by the lines in a stanza (tathnia: two, tathlitha: three, tarbia: four), and names the two parts of a line (ukwapi, the first, and utao, the second), without swapping them or counting mizani instead, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a poem for its message (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.mastery: Tells a short text that describes a person (wasifu), one that tells events in order (masimulizi) and one that explains how something is done or what it is (maelezo), in 8 of 10 new short texts.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to U-U (uji, unga, ugali, usingizi, uchafu, wino, mchele, mchanga: no plural), gives u- as the subject prefix, and does not use ya- or i-, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.mastery: Names the parts of an insha (kichwa, utangulizi, mwili, hitimisho) and puts a sentence in the right part of a wasifu, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the insha (outcomes b and c) is composition marking.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to I-I (afya, njaa, nguvu, subira, heshima, akili, haki, bahati: states and ideas that are not counted), gives i- as the subject prefix, and does not use zi- as for a plural, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.mastery: Completes a nahau about work and teamwork (kuchapa kazi, kuvaa njuga, kuunga mkono, kutoa jasho, kujikaza kisabuni, kufunga mkanda) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a nahau when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.mastery: Matches the word of place and the verb in PA-KU-MU: pa- for a particular place (pale pana), ku- for a far or general place (kule kuna), mu- or m- for inside (mle mna), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.mastery: Picks the word with almost the same meaning (furaha-bashasha, haraka-upesi) and the group of four words that all share one meaning, and does not pick the opposite, a related word or a group with one opposite in it, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.mastery: Tells a play from a story (names of speakers, words spoken, directions in brackets), says what a word in the play means, and answers questions about it, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutendeana: each does it for the other, as in kuandikiana; kutendesha: makes someone do it, as in kuimbisha; kutendua: undoes it, as in kufungua) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.mastery: Tells formal language (for a meeting, a leader, a letter) from informal language (for friends and home) and picks the sentence that fits the person and the place, in 8 of 10 new items. Speaking in each context (outcome b, in full) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.mastery: Gives the true opposite of an adjective (mrefu-mfupi, mzito-mwepesi, mwerevu-mjinga) in the form that agrees with the noun, and does not repeat the word or pick a different adjective, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.mastery: Completes a sitiari about behaviour (Kamau ni nyuki, mkuu wa shule ni simba, mwenzako ni kinyonga) and picks the sentence that is a sitiari and not a tashbihi (with kama) or a plain statement, in 8 of 10 new items. Using sitiari in speech (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..mastery: Uses -ki-, -sipo- and -nge- for a condition (Ukisoma, utafaulu; Usipomwagilia, itakauka; Ningekuwa tajiri, ningejenga) and does not use a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) in its place, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..mastery: Makes the negative of a verb with -ki- by changing -ki- to -sipo- (Ukisoma, Usiposoma) and does not only add si- or keep -ki-, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..mastery: Gives the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-) of nouns that begin with ki- (kitabu: jitabu, kijitabu) and their plurals (majitabu, vijitabu), in 8 of 10 new items.
